prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: a high fidelity direction board for SelfCall, an original Russian video meeting app. Flat front-on UI screencaptures on a neutral #e9edf6 presentation ground with generous consistent gutters. Each screenshot crisp, complete and readable, no cropped screen edges, no phone bezels or perspective, no annotations outside the screens. System sans-serif typography with excellent Cyrillic. Match this common system exactly: cobalt #3045d8, surgical cool off-white #f5f7fc, paper #ffffff, midnight ink #171c32, quiet blue-gray type, blue-tinted secondary surfaces, 12px button corners and 24px card corners. Main action solid cobalt with white type; secondary toned pale blue; tiny cobalt square with a white video camera and 'SelfCall' as brand. Meeting stage and a ringing call use midnight #101424 with softer #1c2340 sheets. Stable, compact controls. Calm, contemporary, recognizably a tool for people. Use only the labels specified, in Russian apart from SelfCall and sample code; no watermarks, stock marketing copy, illustrations of hardware or repeated labels.
Wide artboard. Upper half one large desktop meeting viewport: dark full-bleed video scene with restrained header, 'SelfCall', 'Встреча abc-defg-hjk', mint dot with 'На связи', count and elapsed '00:24', 'Пригласить'; two separated rounded dark blue tiles for camera-off participants with circular initials plus tiny name labels. Wide open breathing room around stable lower dock with five distinct mic/camera/screen/layout/leave icons; white easy-to-identify hangup on deep red. One small dark device popover above mic, menu options 'Микрофон' and 'По умолчанию'. Lower half three smaller equal light desktop viewport snapshots side by side, each slim SelfCall header and centered paper card: 1. blue link icon, 'Проверяем ссылку…', slim progress line. 2. quiet check icon, 'Вы вышли из встречи', buttons 'Вернуться во встречу' and 'На главную'. 3. warning link icon, 'Встреча не найдена', short actionable explanation and button 'На главную'.
